summary: The First Den is a forest world centered on Spawn, where the owner's tree-centered home connects to a lake, creek, activity sites, a north market town, and roads to Hearthmere and Lumenvale. Authored scene rows anchor places and actors; terrain marks, procedural builders, shared data kits, and manager behaviors provide landscape, structures, crowds, and animals. The home now includes a high-tech art studio below its main rooms, while the town square has expanded civic dressing and festoons.
places: places/main - forest world joining Spawn/home, lake and creek sites, camp/corral, and roads to Hearthmere and Lumenvale
places/main/cells/x0z0.scene - Spawn hub: cob-house home/garden and underground studio, creek/waterfall, activities, corral at (-50,-50), orchard, and outbuildings
places/main/cells/x0z-1.scene - lake shore/islet, maze, north-shore blossom walk, camps and lookout; islet-life has pulsing runes and a treasure chest
places/main/cells/x0z1.scene - market town at z≈100: square, regrouped market islands, stepped fountain, hall/Ember, crowd, walled alleys and festoons
places/main/cells/objects.scene - shared authored road and city placements; remaining cells stream structures and actors
places/main/config.yaml - forest terrain, water, site/path/clearing marks, road grading and seeded vegetation; includes clear, flatten and path marks for outbuildings
places/main/cells/x-1z0.scene + x1z0.scene - western/eastern highway verge with distributed trail-stop and flower-basket lamp placements
places/main/cells/x-8z-4.scene - Hearthmere town placements among the streamed city cells

templates/player.js#player - player root with movement, locomotion, home interaction, delete, travel, alchemy and horse-summon behaviors
places/main/config.yaml + scripts/forest-terrain.js - configured forest terrain, height/material interface and landscape marks
places/main/cells/x0z0.scene#cob-house - Spawn's tree-centered multilevel home with below-floor art studio; scripts/gen/cob-house.js defines the shell/stair geometry
places/main/cells/x0z0.scene#corral - horse-ring manager and corral site; three named corral horses use pasture-horse behavior
places/main/cells/x0z1.scene#town-crowd, #town-dragon, #town-square, #town-festoon - managed citizens/Ember and the authored market-town square dressing
scripts/gen/hearth-city.js + scripts/gen/lumen-grand.js - procedural structure roots for Hearthmere and Lumenvale

scripts/gen/forest-plant.js + scripts/gen/valley-mesh.js - seeded vegetation geometry reused by configured decoration layers
scripts/lib/road-solid.js + scripts/lib/solid-kit.js - shared solid/collider construction for road and site builders
scripts/lib/home-interaction.js + scripts/lib/data/home-feel.js - player press targeting and interaction tuning
scripts/lib/dragon-rider.js - mount/seat/dismount coordination shared by Violet, rowboat, courier horse and zipline trolley

scripts/lib/bloom-kit.js - flower/fern/mushroom geometry and seeded helpers reused by garden and landscape builders
scripts/lib/data/corral.yml, scripts/lib/data/steed.js, town/courier/travel data - tuning and rosters consumed by corresponding actors, managers, builders and UI

scripts/player.js - onSpawn(ctx), onInput(ctx,input), update(ctx,dt); scripts/camera.js - update(ctx,dt)
scripts/ui.js - default(ctx, player), HUD for travel, courier, secrets and alchemy
scripts/town-crowd.js - updateSchedule, update(ctx,dt), ears.press; scripts/pasture-flock.js - update(ctx)
scripts/town-dragon.js - onSpawn(ctx), updateSchedule, update(ctx,dt); scripts/corral-horses.js - corral horse-manager behavior

scripts/alchemy-player.js + alchemy data - player harvest spending, alchemy panel/toast, buff expiry and speedMul; player consumes speedMul
scripts/pond-seed.js + fishing-tackle.js + pond data - player seeds/gotSeeds and fish count; seed visibility/respawn and fishing cast/catch state
scripts/pasture-flock.js + pasture-flock.yml - west-pasture manager's flock goals, movement/clip state and grazing sounds for tagged sheep/alpaca rows
scripts/town-crowd.js + town-crowd.yml - spawned townspeople and their movement/press responses; sitting NPC placement accounts for fountain dais rise
scripts/town-dragon.js - Ember's action and roar timers; scripts/gen/roost-dragon.js supplies rig geometry and skeleton
scripts/horse-summon.js + scripts/steed.js + steed data; scripts/corral-horses.js + corral data - summoned mount/rider state and corral horses' managed poses/behavior

flows: places/main/config.yaml terrain generator + seed -> scripts/forest-terrain.js heightAt/materialAt(ctx) -> engine terrain, river channels and forest material bands
terrain site/path marks + decoration layers -> grading, clearing, ground materials and seeded vegetation; scene rows independently draw roads and structures
move/look/jump/camView input -> scripts/player.js -> movement, jump, flight and camMode; templates/player.js attaches home interaction, travel, alchemy and horse handlers
Z input -> scripts/horse-summon.js spawns a session steed using steed data and courier-horse geometry -> scripts/steed.js controls the horse and rider
player presses mandala-crystal -> harvest; alchemy-bench press -> alchemyOpen -> alchemy-player brew spends harvest and sets buff -> scripts/ui.js presents panel/status
pond seed trigger / pouch press -> scripts/pond-seed.js -> player seeds and gotSeeds; fishing-tackle press/cast/reel -> player fish count and catch feedback
west-pasture manager + pasture-flock.yml -> tagged sheep/alpaca target positions and species clips; animation clips are registered in world.facts.yaml
corral site + corral data -> scripts/corral-horses.js coordinates tagged corral horses and their graze/nicker/stand/swish/walk clips registered in world.facts.yaml
town-crowd.yml roster -> town-crowd.js seeds townspeople under the square manager; citizen pressTo routes press to manager -> nearest person turns/answers
town scene rows + town.json -> town-square/house/hall/fountain/festoon and town-alleys builders; town-crowd seating positions use fountainDais rise
town-hall drape/flag rows -> town-banner geometry and material-banner-wave shader; ax/ay orient the GPU wave from fixed edge to free edge
travel input/actions -> scripts/travel.js + travel data -> player travel state/teleport; scripts/ui.js renders destinations and emits travelGo
behaviorFamilies: places/main/config.yaml decoration layers + scripts/gen/forest-plant.js / valley-mesh.js - seeded forest flora varied by layer, kind and terrain

scripts/gen/cob-house.js + scripts/gen/cob-furnish.js - tree-centered multilevel home and furnishing family varied by item, dimensions, palette and seed; art-studio builder supplies specialized lower-level workroom props
scripts/gen/road-bridge.js + scripts/lib/road-solid.js - bridge geometry/collider varied by dimensions and seed; terrain roads separately supply edges and shoulders
scripts/gen/deer-fence.js - perimeter runs/gates vary by points, width and style
animal builders + fauna behaviors; pasture and corral managers - varied species with manager-driven flock/herd motion and registered clips
scripts/gen/hearth-city.js + hearth-city data; scripts/gen/lumen-grand.js - procedural structure roots for Hearthmere and Lumenvale

scripts/gen/{town-square,town-house,town-hall,town-fountain,town-festoon,town-alleys,town-banner}.js + town-kit - market/civic structures, alleys, flags and square dressing varied by kind, palette, seed and placement
scripts/gen/{blossom-walk,orchard,corral,islet-life,zip-landing}.js and bloom-kit - reusable landscape/site props varied by parts, points, species, seed and site parameters
probableOrphans: scripts/flat-terrain.js - no current place config selects it; main uses forest-terrain
scripts/jade-dragon.js - no scene behavior row attaches this actor script; scripts/gen/jade-dragon.js geometry may still be used
migrationNotes: forest-terrain heightAt/materialAt take a context object; main river is at sea level y=0, ground is around y=0.5, and Spawn clearing is centered near (0,-3).

Keep terrain material IDs, clear/flatten marks and decoration bindings coordinated with scene placement; Spawn/home grounds are near (0,-27), corral is centered at (-50,-50), and town lane/square clearings run north to z=100.
Terrain path marks grade/materialize routes and clear scatter; scene road/path builders draw visible paving and do not replace terrain jobs. Keep road marks and site dressing aligned.
The cob-house studio is below the main house floor: art-studio piece origins use feet on its studio floor and face -Z; preserve the small dry terrain pocket around the house for the sunk studio.

Town square builders use local coordinates around the row at (0,0.55,100), while town-world data, square paving wear, alleys/walls and market props must stay aligned to that shared datum; seated crowd elevation includes fountainDais.rise.

Town banner cloth uses a fixed hoist/rod edge and shader params ax/ay define wave direction; preserve flag versus drape geometry orientation and matching material parameters. Revised animal/dragon clips coexist with source-name aliases in world.facts.yaml, so preserve registered clip keys when changing assignments.
